interpretation.plain_speak: The frozen detector catches about two-thirds of imminent flips one update early, but only about one in three warnings becomes a flip. That is useful evidence that Wingless can see trouble coming, but it is still too noisy to justify acting automatically.
interpretation.north_star_question: This is the first direct held-out test of a calibrated native-state failure-risk estimate. It works above chance in an operational sense, but its precision must improve or its false-warning cost must be shown harmless before bounded intervention.
interpretation.next_stage: run a held-out predictor ablation comparing the frozen rank-plus-temporal model against a static-rank-only model to measure whether temporal history actually improves predictive calibration out of sample
